test_title: PYST 25: SSC JE ME - Reassoning (Held on: 14 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: L, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S are eight people sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them sit at the corners while others sit at the exact centre of the sides. R sits at one of the corners of the table with M and O sitting on either of his sides. Q sits to the immediate left of M. P does not sit at any of the corners and is not the immediate neighbour of Q. N sits third to the left of S. Who sits second to the left of P?
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: R sits at one of the corners of the table with M and O sitting on either of his sides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2797e16143978323d2ab439ca57cf376c0be89682b0efdf902eaecd481f40ee1.png] 

We place R at a corner and then place M and O such that left position of M is vacant.

Step 2: Q sits to the immediate left of M.
